title: Alkawal Reedu
intro: E nder cuuɗi silki ɓernde teskinnde e Diine, hunnde ceniinde miijaama. Ndee ɗoo hunaare ina tuugnii e nguurndam ɗam fotaani fooftaade, tee timmal mum ina wayla laawol ndonu ruuhu haa abada. Tappu e nder sirlu ruuhu mo fodoore mum ƴellitii e nder haa abada.
clues: Miɗo hoɗi e galle ganndiraaɗo dewal, miɗo yiɗi dokkal ɓadtoowal mi Alla.
Mi waɗii alkawal mawngal e Joomiraawo am ko fayti e ko suuɗii e nder am, mi huniima ɗum fof e golle makko.
Nde waktu udditgol oo ari, ko keɓ-mi koo, ko mi sikkaano, kono mi halfinii haala kaa e juuɗe Annduɗo fof.
Mi rokkii ɓiɗɗo am innde hollitoore dewal, mi ñaagii nde o reenata mo e iwdi makko e kuddi oo.
Ɓiɗɗo am oo waɗaama e nder suudu ceniindu, e les njiimaandi annabi gooto ummoriiɗo e leñol Haaruuna.
Ɓiɗɗo am debbo oo anndaama e laaɓal mum, o suɓaama e dow rewɓe fof, caggal ɗuum o woni yumma annabi mawɗo, hay so tawii o heddii ko o memotaako.

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Alkawal ngam hokkugo ɓinngel maako ngel walaa nder reedu maako haa suudu dewal
Jarribo muñal rewrude e ñawu juutngu
Ko kaawisaaji nguura ummoraade e asamaan
trial.answer: Alkawal ngam hokkugo ɓinngel maako ngel walaa nder reedu maako haa suudu dewal

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Ɓiɗɗo makko jaɓaama e juuɗe Alla, mawni e les njiimaandi annabaagal
Ɓiɗɗo makko rokkaama hakkille e jawdi keewndi
outcome.answer: Ɓiɗɗo makko jaɓaama e juuɗe Alla, mawni e les njiimaandi annabaagal

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
